remarks: A rare opportunity to own a triplex in the highly desirable Eastside Costa Mesa neighborhood. Tucked along Woodland Place, a quiet residential cul-de-sac, this 3-unit property offers an appealing combination of location, income potential and long-term investment opportunity in coastal Orange County. Situated on an approximately 6,118 SqFt lot, the property features 2 generously sized 2 bedroom : 1 bath units and a 3 bedroom : 2 bathroom unit. The individual floor plans provide functional living spaces suited to a variety of tenant needs.
